scope: Core and UI sequence ownership, conditional event reuse, matching completion assumption, raw buffers, author-host isolation and actual browser verification.
fixedDuringReview: A previously invalid current-result ticket could regain authority if a silently changed context/sample returned to its old value; current now permanently marks an observed invalid ticket revoked.
Undo raw input history has a separate 256KiB UTF8 budget; oversized hidden inputs cannot bypass history bounds through a completion step.
testHarnessCorrections: New direct UI fixture required the existing animationStateEventPreviewKeys helper; shared rows were empty only in the test harness. The helper is now supplied generically.
independentReviews: Core checked every provided event sample through existing admission and Rust scalar comparison; completion examines only admitted table geometry.
History and current pending result are separate. Undo restores raw buffers through the UI path, while immutable truncation creates new core identity.
Completion mode ignores hidden event samples and the optional scalar comparison marker, but full author-table admission remains required.
unchanged: Original event evaluator and its pure/native tests
limitations: Manual adoption assumes the predicted entry succeeds; real rejected select/play/inactive behavior is separately asserted.
Completion assumes the selected clip notification has arrived; no playback clock, looping or live clip matching simulation.
No new installed Tauri, Android, Bevy animation or ZIP-delivery verification.
